title: Independent Bonnet--Myers diameter and compactness theorem
abstract: Formalizes the classical Bonnet--Myers theorem for complete connected smooth boundaryless finite-dimensional real Riemannian manifolds. From dimension n >= 2, K > 0, and the pointwise lower bound Ric(a,a) >= (n-1) K g(a,a), the selected theorem constructs the Levi--Civita connection and actual curvature, proves compactness, and gives the sharp induced extended-diameter bound pi/sqrt K. The development proves minimizing-geodesic, parallel-transport, second-variation, index-form, and metric-compactness bridges rather than assuming them.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
